title: EGCG-mediated selenium nanoparticles protect against 5-fluorouracil-induced cardiotoxicity via Nrf2/Keap1 signaling.
authors: Alam-ElDein, Khaled M; Abdelaziz, Moustafa Mahmoud; Elgezery, Salma Sabry; Fouad, Youssef Tarek; Mousa, Miriam Amir; Elmosilhi, Ahmed M; Mohamed, Malak Mostafa; Abdo, Salma A; Ali, Mennatallah T; Mohamed, Basmala Shaher; Hanafy, Radwa A; Elhemiely, Alzahraa A; Gadelmawla, Mohamed H A; Mahran, Nievin Ahmed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EGCG硒纳米颗粒对5-氟尿嘧啶诱导心脏毒性的保护作用，聚焦Nrf2/Keap1信号通路，仅含少量分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: 5-Fluorouracil (5-FU) is a widely used anticancer drug; however, its clinical application is limited by severe adverse effects, particularly cardiotoxicity. This study investigated the cardioprotective potential of epigallocatechin gallat-mediated selenium nanoparticles (EGCG-SeNPs) against 5-FU-induced cardiac injury in rats and explored the underlying mechanisms, with a specific focus on comparing the efficacy of the combined therapy versus EGCG or selenium monotherapy. In silico molecular docking was performed to evaluate the interaction of EGCG with inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), glutathione S-transferase (GST), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha). Thirty-five male Wistar rats were randomly assigned to five groups: control, 5-FU, Na((2))SeO((3))&5-FU, EGCG&5-FU, and EGCG-SeNPs&5-FU. Cardiotoxicity was induced by intraperitoneal administration of 5-FU (30 mg/kg) for five consecutive days, while treatments were administered orally for 21 days. Cardiac injury biomarkers, oxidative stress parameters, inflammatory mediators, and apoptotic markers were evaluated using biochemical assays, ELISA, qRT-PCR, immunohistochemistry for Nrf2/Keap1 signaling, and histopathological examination. 5-FU induced significant cardiotoxicity, evidenced by elevated CK-MB, LDH, and troponin levels; increased lipid peroxidation; depletion of antioxidant defenses; activation of inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and NF-kB); suppression of IL-10; and enhanced apoptosis, accompanied by myocardial histopathological damage and reduced Nrf2 immunoreactivity. Treatment with EGCG or sodium selenite attenuated these alterations, while EGCG-SeNPs exerted cardioprotective effects, restoring redox balance, suppressing inflammation and apoptosis, modulating Nrf2/Keap1 signaling, and preserving myocardial architecture. EGCG-mediated selenium nanoparticles exhibit potent cardioprotective effects through antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiapoptotic mechanisms. These findings highlight the therapeutic potential of EGCG-SeNPs as a promising cardioprotective strategy during 5-FU chemotherapy.
abstract_zh: 5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）是一种广泛使用的抗癌药物；然而，其临床应用受到严重不良反应的限制，尤其是心脏毒性。本研究探讨了表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯介导的硒纳米颗粒（EGCG-SeNPs）对大鼠5-FU诱导心脏损伤的心脏保护潜力，并探索了其潜在机制，特别关注联合治疗与EGCG或硒单药治疗效果的比较。通过计算机分子对接（in silico molecular docking）评估EGCG与诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）的相互作用。三十五只雄性Wistar大鼠被随机分为五组：对照组、5-FU组、Na((2))SeO((3))&5-FU组、EGCG&5-FU组和EGCG-SeNPs&5-FU组。通过连续五天腹腔注射5-FU（30 mg/kg）诱导心脏毒性，而治疗药物则口服给药21天。使用生化检测、ELISA、qRT-PCR、Nrf2/Keap1信号通路的免疫组织化学以及组织病理学检查评估心脏损伤生物标志物、氧化应激参数、炎症介质和凋亡标志物。5-FU诱导了显著的心脏毒性，表现为CK-MB、LDH和肌钙蛋白水平升高；脂质过氧化增加；抗氧化防御耗竭；炎症细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和NF-kB）激活；IL-10抑制；以及凋亡增强，伴随心肌组织病理学损伤和Nrf2免疫反应性降低。EGCG或亚硒酸钠治疗减轻了这些改变，而EGCG-SeNPs发挥了心脏保护作用，恢复了氧化还原平衡，抑制了炎症和凋亡，调节了Nrf2/Keap1信号通路，并保护了心肌结构。EGCG介导的硒纳米颗粒通过抗氧化、抗炎和抗凋亡机制表现出强效的心脏保护作用。这些发现凸显了EGCG-SeNPs作为5-FU化疗期间有前景的心脏保护策略的治疗潜力。
